Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing leaves of absence for full-time certificated and classified employees serving as peace corps volunteers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to leaves of absence for peace corps volunteers;and adding a new section to chapter 28A.400 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: School district boards of directors shall grant leaves of absencewithout pay for at least two years to any fulltime certificated orclassified employee who serves as a volunteer in the peace corps whovolunteers for the peace corps at the time the person is a fulltimeemployee. Upon expiration of the leave, the certificated or classifiedemployee shall have the right to be reinstated to the position heldbefore the leave was granted at the salary rate prevailing for thatposition when the employee resumes duty, without loss of seniority orsick leave. This section does not apply to employees who fail toreport back to their districts within ninety days after termination ofservice with the peace corps.
